---
title: "Query ERA5-Land For Kenya"
subtitle: "Download the first project artifacts from CDS"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

This page turns the first Climate-CAFE script into a manual step the operator
can execute and verify.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Access To CDS"}

Before querying ERA5-Land data, confirm that the required client library and
credentials are available.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("README.md").exists(), "Expected to run this page from the project root."
assert Path.home().joinpath(".cdsapirc").exists(), "Expected CDS credentials in ~/.cdsapirc."
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare The Query Scope"}

Define the minimum set of parameters needed for a first ERA5-Land query.

```{python}
#| eval: false
request = {
    "dataset": "reanalysis-era5-land",
    "country": "Kenya",
    "year": "2020",
    "month": "01",
}
request
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Prepare The Output Directory"}

Create a location for raw downloaded files.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

raw_dir = Path("data/raw/era5land")
raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
raw_dir
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Query Readiness"}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

raw_dir = Path("data/raw/era5land")
assert raw_dir.exists(), "Expected the raw ERA5-Land directory to exist."
assert raw_dir.is_dir(), "Expected data/raw/era5land to be a directory."
```

:::
